notes.title: Update #1 - Fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who has been playing the game!


I'm planning to continue supporting the game, as well as add more features and content in the future. For now I've mostly been fixing small issues and polishing stuff.

Patch Notes:

 Fixed a bug where player damage accumulator was kept between rounds
 Fixed a bug where bots could collect achievements like regular players
 Fixed a couple of small typos in the czech translation
 Updated the Swedish translation
 Fixed the 'Fire' button in HUD
 Fixed an issue related to telepoter projectile bouncing off of players
 Added simple missing achievement descriptions
 Disasters are now faster, stronger and don't wait so many turns
 Fixed bot logic for picking weapons
 Each powerup now has an icon
 Optimized the explosions and terrain edits, it should be much faster especially on low-power devices like laptops
 Added a couple of missing chinese characters which previously didn't render properly
 Fixed a bug where playing with the 'free teleporter' option would recharge guns faster


I also worked on the linux build using Proton. I got it working just a while ago, so I uploaded a build but it's still experimental. It should be stable in the next patch.

I'm also considering adding a short tutorial + campaign set of levels. It could make it considerably easier for players to learn all of the game mechanics.

Cheers,
Jakub

notes.title: Solar Storm Release is 3 days away!!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to show everyone what I've been working on for the last few months! The game is coming along nicely, everything is basically finished. I've been fixing some bugs and adding more languages in the last couple of days.

Most of the really cool weapons were not in the Demo, so I'm looking forward to players seeing them for the first time.

Since this is my first Steam game, there is still a lot of unknowns for me. But I hope everything goes well and there aren't too many bugs haha :)

Anyway, if you want to chat with me or other people in this community, you can join my Discord Server

I'm also fairly active on twitter, so if you're curious about the behind the scenes on the developmenent you can give me a follow.

I'm not sure how often I'll post here on the steam community, but I will try to at least put patch notes and major announcements here :)

Thank you for all the positive feedback so far! Cheers
Jakub
